line: That's the one who sorted the Nexus. Shift the plank, let them by.

thought: glad the player is back whole; puts it in a builder's words
line: Back in one piece, I see. Better built than most, you.

thought: heard Ocellus was put down; would build a statue if there were stone
line: Saw off Ocellus, they say. I'd build you a statue if I had the stone.

thought: notices the player's hands like a builder would, half joking
line: Steady hands, you've got. Shame to waste them on a sword.

thought: offers the finished half of the bridge as a courtesy
line: Go on, use the finished half of the bridge. You've earned it.

thought: soldiers talk, the player got on with it, which a builder respects
line: Soldiers talk, you just got on with it. That's my kind of worker.

thought: saved the archive but still won't pass a nail
line: Saved the whole archive and still too grand to hand me a nail, pal.

thought: the Nexus didn't need a roof; the camp does
line: Took the Nexus, did you? The Nexus didn't need a roof. My camp does.

thought: to a mate: the hero is tracking dust over new boards
line: There goes the hero, tracking vault dust over my new boards.

thought: faced a guardian of Guthix but is wary of a half-built bridge
line: Fought a guardian of Guthix and you're wary of a half-built bridge?

thought: heard about the room full of chests; none for the builders
line: All them chests of treasure and not one plank for the builders, eh?

thought: treasure for heroes, splinters for builders
line: Treasure for the heroes and splinters for us. Fair's fair, I suppose.

thought: the player is standing about looking heroic while the work waits
line: Don't stand there looking heroic. Looking heroic won't hold up a wall.

thought: muttering: strangers come out legends and the builder is still on planks
line: In go strangers, out come legends, and here's me still on planks.

thought: watches the roots gripping the crystal rocks as if holding them in
line: The roots hold those crystals so tightly. Something wants them kept.

thought: Guthix's followers built this place for his treasures; now the alliance keeps it
line: His followers built this place for Guthix's treasures. We keep it now.

thought: Lucien took the Stone and the way in opened; a druid sees the balance in it
line: Lucien took the Stone of Jas and the way in opened. Balance, of sorts.

thought: asks the player to step round the roots; they have work to do too
line: Mind the roots as you pass. They've a job to do, same as us.

thought: Saradomin's knights and Armadyl's guardians side by side, a strange balance
line: Saradomin's knights beside Armadyl's guardians. Strange times.

thought: looters from every side, each sure the archive is theirs
line: Looters from every side, each one sure the archive should be theirs.

thought: whatever's in the inner vault, the Stone of Jas was trouble enough
line: Whatever sits in the inner vault, the Stone of Jas was bad enough.

thought: heard the defence is barely holding; the roots are doing better
line: Barely holding, they say. The roots hold better than we do.

thought: Ivy Sophista herself sent for this adventurer; that means something to a druid
line: Ivy Sophista sent for you. That's no small thing, among us.

thought: the player walks past the roots without trampling them
line: You walk softly for an adventurer. The roots don't seem to mind you.

thought: glad of any friend the archive can get while the defence is thin
line: Glad you came. The archive needs every friend it can get just now.

thought: to another druid: this one came all the way down the chasm to help
line: All the way down the Chasm of Tears to help us, that one. Good heart.

thought: notices balance in the player: nothing overdone
line: You've a balanced look about you. Not too much of anything.

thought: the player came to defend, which is the druids' own way
line: Here to defend it, not to take it. That's the right way round.

thought: thanks the player: the knights couldn't have held it alone
line: Thank you for coming. The knights alone could never have held it.

thought: judges the player won't grab at what isn't theirs
line: You'll do right by this place, I think. You don't grab at things.

thought: the player nearly treads on the roots that hold the crystals
line: Do mind the roots. They're holding more together than you are.

thought: suspicious: help, or another sack to fill like the looters?
line: Here to help, are you? Not to fill a sack like the rest? We'll see.

thought: to another druid: this one trod right over the roots
line: Trod straight over the roots, that one. They always do.

thought: the player has the look of someone who'd mine the crystal rocks bare
line: You've the look of someone who'd mine those crystals bare.

thought: adventurers rush; a druid would have them stand still a moment
line: All hurry and no balance, adventurers. Try standing still a moment.

thought: break nothing inside; the archive is older than the player's manners
line: Break nothing in the archive, please. It's older than your manners.

thought: gentle sarcasm about putting nature aside to go and hit things
line: Nature can wait, I suppose, while you go and hit things.

thought: fight to defend, not to collect; did the player hear that bit?
line: Fight to defend, not to collect. You did hear that part?

thought: Ocellus was set to guard and wanted to rule instead
line: Ocellus was set to guard the Blade, not want it. Even guardians fall.

thought: Ivy doubts Ocellus is gone, since Guthix gave him his power
line: Ivy Sophista doubts Ocellus is truly gone. Guthix's gifts run deep.

thought: the guardians' names are handed down; Ocellus's will be said more quietly now
line: We still hand down the guardians' names. Ocellus's sounds sadder now.

thought: some would bury the archive; Ivy won't, nor will this druid
line: Bury the archive? Ivy Sophista won't hear of it, and nor will I.

thought: repeating Ivy: the artefacts are like fire, learned slowly
line: Those artefacts are like fire, Ivy says. Slowly, or not at all.

thought: the broken Blade hangs from a vine, still giving off power, like strange fruit
line: A broken blade on a vine, still thick with power. Strange fruit.

thought: Ivy would even take the Dagon'hai as allies now; balance is hard
line: Ivy would take the Dagon'hai as allies now. Balance is a hard road.

thought: puzzles over a lighthouse lens casing in the vault
line: A lighthouse lens casing in the vault. What did Guthix want with that?

thought: the player stood against Ocellus for the balance
line: You stood against Ocellus for the balance. We won't forget it.

thought: Guthix meant the archive to open when the world was ready; the player helped
line: Guthix meant this place to open one day. Folk like you bring it near.

thought: to another druid: this one faced Ocellus and walked out again
line: That one faced Ocellus in the vault, and walked out again.

thought: the player took only the rewards offered, not the relics
line: Took what the chests offered and no more. Rarer than you'd think.

thought: Ivy Sophista was right to send for this one
line: Ivy Sophista chose well when she sent for you.

thought: the player fought to defend, the druids' way near enough
line: You fought to defend it, not to own it. That's our way, near enough.

thought: thanks the player: Guthix's things are safe, for a while
line: Thank you. Guthix's things are safe again, for a while at least.

thought: the player would make a fair druid: knows when to stop
line: You'd make a fair druid, I think. You know when to stop.

thought: saved the archive and went straight for the chests
line: Saved the archive, then straight to the chests. Balance, I suppose.

thought: Ocellus thought only Guthix worthy of the Blade; the player shouldn't get ideas
line: Ocellus thought only Guthix worthy of that blade. Don't get ideas.

thought: Ivy says fire burns those who rush, and the player does rush
line: Fire burns those who rush, Ivy says. You do rush.

thought: to another druid: that one's pack is heavier coming out
line: That one's pack is heavier coming out than going in, I'd wager.

thought: hero of the vault, still treads on every root
line: Hero of the vault, and still you step on every root.

thought: Ivy doubts Ocellus is dead, so no boasting yet
line: Ivy doubts Ocellus is really dead. Don't go boasting just yet.

thought: the player walks out of the vault as if they owned it; nobody does
line: You walk out of that vault like you own it. Nobody owns it.

thought: nature thanks the player, and would thank them more for clean boots
line: Nature thanks you. It would thank you more if you'd wipe your boots.

thought: even the vague Record Keeper admits they're struggling
line: Even the Record Keeper says we're struggling. He's rarely that plain.

thought: a Saradominist justiciar calling Temple Knights servants of evil
line: A justiciar of Saradomin, calling Temple Knights servants of evil.

thought: the scouts' tale of one knight wiping out a whole squad
line: A lone knight cut down a whole squad, the scouts say. One knight.

thought: on watch with druids; steadier than expected
line: Druids on watch with us. Steadier than they look, I'll grant them.

thought: every rabble with a god behind it has come to loot
line: Every rabble with a god behind it has come to loot this place.

thought: the general's scouts report the goblins follow a huge ork
line: The general's scouts say the goblins follow a huge ork. Huge, mind.

thought: Eva leads in plain White Knight armour; no airs, and the knight respects it
line: Eva Cashien leads in plain White Knight armour. No airs about her.

thought: skeletons and Zamorakian mages fighting each other below; let them
line: Skeletons and Zamorakian mages at each other below. Let them.

thought: the player looks ready to go in
line: Ready to go in, by the look of you. Saradomin guard your back.

thought: the alliance needed more than knights; glad it's the player
line: We needed more than knights down here. Glad it's you.

thought: the player carries themselves like someone who has stood a watch
line: You carry yourself like you've stood a watch before.

thought: to the knight alongside: walks in meaning to come back out
line: That one walks in like they mean to come back out. Good discipline.

thought: the alliance is stronger with the player in it
line: Steady, adventurer. The alliance is stronger for having you.

thought: came to defend, not strip it, which puts them above most who come down
line: You came to defend it, not strip it. That puts you above most.

thought: whatever god the player keeps, they are welcome on the line
line: Whatever god you keep, you're welcome on this line.

thought: would stand a watch beside the player any day
line: I'd stand a watch beside you any day, adventurer.

thought: the player is slouching about a war camp
line: Stand up straight. The enemy can see you slouching from the archive.

thought: gawping at the ravine holds no line
line: Gawping at the ravine won't hold the line. Move along.

thought: to the knight alongside: this one's late, the looters were quicker
line: That one's late. The looters got here first.

thought: the player would make a poor Temple Knight, too much wandering
line: You'd make a poor Temple Knight, adventurer. Too much wandering.

thought: the enemy is at the door and the player is admiring the bank
line: The enemy's at the door, and you're out here admiring the bank?

thought: in or out; standing about helps nobody
line: In or out, adventurer. Standing about helps nobody.

thought: even the goblins brought a siege engine
line: Even the goblins brought a siege engine. What did you bring?

thought: the player wouldn't last a day in drill; lucky there's a war on
line: You'd not last a day at drill. Lucky for you there's a war on.

thought: the Nexus is taken; now it must be held, chamber by chamber
line: The Nexus is ours. Now we hold it, chamber by chamber.

thought: Ocellus was set to guard and chose to rule: a knight's worst failing
line: Ocellus was set to guard, and chose to rule. A knight's worst failing.

thought: agrees with Eva that Guthix did well to seal the old magic away
line: Eva Cashien says Guthix did well to seal this magic away. I agree.

thought: the justiciar wouldn't be talked round
line: That justiciar called us servants of evil. Wouldn't be told otherwise.

thought: the Dagon'hai broke with Lucien and still want the archive
line: The Dagon'hai broke with Lucien and want the archive for themselves.

thought: Armacus Selles likes a joke; a good thing down here
line: Armacus Selles is fond of a joke. A good thing, down here.

thought: a demon in full command of its flames near where the Stone sat
line: A demon that commands its own flames, near where the Stone of Jas sat.

thought: the vault's plinths of relics, none of them theirs to touch
line: Plinths of relics in that vault. None of them ours to touch.

thought: the player helped take the Nexus; the alliance owes them
line: You helped take the Nexus. The alliance owes you, and we know it.

thought: faced Ocellus and came back; Saradomin was with them whoever they pray to
line: Faced Ocellus and came back. Saradomin was with you, whoever's yours.

thought: to the knight alongside: that's the one, stand straight
line: That's the one who took the Nexus with us. Stand straight.

thought: the player has discipline enough to wear white
line: Discipline like that, you'd do well in white. Not that I'm asking.

thought: the defence was barely holding when the player came; it holds now
line: We were barely holding when you came down. We hold now.

thought: good work in the vault, duty done properly
line: Good work in the vault, adventurer. Duty done, and done properly.

thought: the line holds better with the player on it
line: The line holds better with you on it. That's all I'll say.

thought: whatever's left of Ocellus, they'd sooner the player faced it
line: Whatever's left of Ocellus, I'd sooner you faced it than me.

thought: took the Nexus and now wanders the camp like a market
line: Took the Nexus, and now you wander the camp like it's a market day.

thought: hero of the vault who can't stand a watch without fidgeting
line: Hero of the vault. Still can't stand a watch without fidgeting.

thought: to the knight alongside: straight to the bank with the winnings
line: Straight to the bank with the winnings, that one. Duty, is it?

thought: Ocellus forgot his post; the player shouldn't forget theirs
line: Ocellus forgot his post. Don't you forget yours.

thought: Ezekiel called everyone in his way evil; in the player's case, half fair
line: The justiciar called everyone in his way evil. Half right about you.

thought: the player would be a fine knight if they ever stood still
line: You'd be a fine knight, if you ever stood still long enough.

thought: saved the archive, but there's no salute every time they pass
line: Saved the archive. Don't expect a salute every time you pass.

thought: faced Ocellus and still dawdles; evil doesn't
line: Faced down Ocellus and you still dawdle. The forces of evil don't.

thought: counting the stock and a fish has gone missing
line: Brews counted, restores counted. Where's that fish got to?

thought: someone keeps putting the congealed leftovers back in the stock
line: Who keeps putting the leftovers back in my stock? They're congealed.

thought: gave up fighting, but crates are hard on the back
line: Gave up fighting, I did. Carrying crates is harder on the back.

thought: the Guardians keep promising more potions; he'll believe it when he sees it
line: The Guardians keep shouting more potions are coming. Are they, though?

thought: barely holding up in the camp; the potions are what's barely holding here
line: Barely holding up top, they say. Same goes for my potions.

thought: the crates have only just come down and half are gone already
line: Only just got these crates down, and they're half gone already.

thought: fish for the hungry, brews for the hurt; sharing it fairly is the trick
line: Fish for the hungry, brews for the hurt. Keeping it fair's the trick.

thought: the navigators bring them in, he kits them out, off they go
line: The navigators bring them in, I kit them out, and off they go.

thought: cheerful greeting; the player has held up better than most
line: Ah, hello! You've held up better than most who come through here.

thought: the player isn't grabbing every brew at once, which is rare
line: Not grabbing every brew in sight. You'd be surprised how rare that is.

thought: folk like the player are why he's down here
line: Folk like you are why I'm down here. Somebody has to keep you going.

thought: to a Guardian nearby: still on their feet, saves a brew
line: That one's still on their feet. Saves me a brew, that does.

thought: Ivy Sophista's adventurer gets the first pick of the fish
line: Ivy Sophista's adventurer? Then first pick of the fish is yours.

thought: the player does the hard part; he only counts potions
line: You do the hard part. All I do is count the potions.

thought: polite ones get the fresh fish, not the leftovers
line: Polite ones like you get the fresh fish, not the leftovers.

thought: a friendly face this deep is scarcer than restores
line: A friendly face, this deep in. Scarcer than restores, those are.

thought: offers the leftovers, if the player is brave or desperate
line: The leftovers are still going, if you're feeling brave. Or desperate.

thought: pretends he saw the player take a second brew
line: Don't think I didn't see that second brew go, mind.

thought: the player eats like a whole squad; the stock can't keep up
line: You eat like a whole squad on your own. My stock can't keep up.

thought: to a Guardian: here's another who'll want the last restore
line: Here comes another one who'll want the last restore. Always the last.

thought: polite caution: it's a war, not a picnic
line: Do bear in mind this is a war, not a picnic. One brew at a time.

thought: still alive, so the brew he counted wasn't wasted
line: Still alive? Good. I'd hate to have counted that brew for nothing.

thought: the player would take the crate itself
line: You'd take the whole crate if I let you, wouldn't you?

thought: all the fish gone, and he can see where it went
line: All the fish gone already? Ah. I can see where it went.

thought: the bowl of leftovers seems to come back on its own
line: Leftovers again. I swear that bowl comes back on its own.

thought: the Nexus is taken, and still the brews go faster than he can count
line: Nexus taken, and still the brews go faster than I can count them.

thought: heard of a room ringed with chests; none ever comes back to him
line: A room ringed with chests, they say. Not one ever comes back to me.

thought: prayer potions low again; everyone, apparently
line: Prayer potions low again. Who's praying that much? Everyone, it seems.

thought: familiar greeting to a returning raider
line: Ah, hello again! You know how it works by now, I expect.

thought: told to manage the supplies; nobody said manage the raiders
line: Manage the supplies, they told me. Nobody said manage the raiders.

thought: the navigators bring them through at a run, no time to tidy
line: The navigators bring them through at a run. Never a moment to tidy.

thought: so much fish you'd think the archive sat by the sea
line: Fish, fish and more fish. You'd think the archive sat by the sea.

thought: it's the one who helped take the Nexus; best fish for them
line: Ah, hello! It's the one who helped take the Nexus. Best fish for you.

thought: the player never wastes a drop; customers like that make the job
line: Customers like you make the job worth doing. Never a drop wasted.

thought: to a Guardian: that one helped take the Nexus, give them the good brews
line: That one helped take the Nexus. The good brews, then.

thought: he doesn't fight any more, but he knows a good fighter
line: I don't fight any more, but I know a good fighter. That's you.

thought: glad to see the player again: best customer, least bother
line: Good to see you again. My best customer, and the least bother.

thought: without raiders he'd only be guarding crates
line: Without you raiders I'd only be guarding crates. Thank you, truly.

thought: the player will make the stock last; a sensible sort
line: You'll make the stock last, I can tell. Sensible sort.

thought: seen the player come back through more than once, still whole
line: Back through again, and still in one piece. You make my job easy.

thought: saved the archive and still can't pass up a free fish
line: Saved the whole archive and you still can't pass up a free fish.

thought: the chests not deep enough? back for his fish as well
line: Chests not deep enough for you, then? Back for my fish as well?

thought: to a Guardian: eats like a squad, thanks like a goblin
line: There's the hero. Eats like a squad and thanks like a goblin.

thought: saving the leftovers specially for the player
line: Kept the leftovers back just for you. Don't say I never do anything.

thought: polite caution: heroes queue for brews like anyone
line: Do bear in mind a hero still queues for brews like everybody else.

thought: took the Nexus and still can't carry their own potions
line: You took the Nexus and still can't carry your own potions?

thought: is that his last restore in the player's pack?
line: Is that my last restore in your pack? It looks a lot like mine.

thought: a legend of the alliance who leaves empty vials on his crate
line: A legend of the alliance, and you leave your empty vials on my crate.
